facts.fact: The page states that the Turkish advertising regulation on influencer disclosure has been in force since 1 August 2026.

facts.fact: Under the page's description of Turkish disclosure rules, posts made in return for any benefit must carry the word 'Reklam' or 'Tanıtım' together with the advertiser's name, visible at first glance.
facts.quote: must carry the word 'Reklam' (advertisement) or 'Tanıtım' (promotion) together with the advertiser's name, visible at first glance.

facts.fact: The page states that gifted products and invitations also count as a benefit under Turkish influencer disclosure rules.
facts.quote: Gifted products and invitations also count as a benefit.

facts.fact: House of Lein states that tens of millions of people in Turkey are on social platforms (vendor's own characterization, no exact figure given).
facts.quote: with tens of millions of people on social platforms.

facts.fact: House of Lein states it has two offices in Istanbul, located in Etiler (Beşiktaş) and Ataşehir.
facts.quote: House of Lein has two offices in Istanbul: in Etiler (Beşiktaş) and in Ataşehir.

facts.fact: The vendor states that most influencer collaborations in Turkey run on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, with LinkedIn increasingly used for B2B brands (vendor's own view, no source cited).
facts.quote: Most influencer collaborations in Turkey run on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube; LinkedIn is increasingly used for B2B brands.
